assembly.why: observed: 34 pad-bearing part(s) on F and 1 on B, 2 reflow pass(es). every footprint BLOCK (#726): blocks sharing one reference are keyed with an ordinal suffix and counted separately. `pad_bearing` restricts that to blocks carrying at least one pad that is not a paste/mask aperture (#1143), and it is the count the populated-side verdict is taken from -- a zero-pad graphic on the back does not make a board double-sided.

budget_withheld.decaps.max_distance_mm: the reference board <the source board, withheld>: only 1 tether(s) on the emitting board -- a max over 1 sample(s) is a coordinate, not a limit (DECAP_MIN_SAMPLE=3) (2 rail-sharing cap(s) lie beyond the 5.0mm search radius, worst 6.852mm)
budget_withheld.oob_count: the board is a pile: its off-board count is staging, not a baseline (#1103)
budget_withheld.overlap_area: the board is a pile: its overlap is staging, not a baseline (#1103)

decap_census.metric: cap footprint centroid to IC bounding box, clamped to 0 inside (placement.groups.decap_tethers)

context.keepouts_note: empty because a keep-out is a mechanical fact -- an enclosure rib, a standoff, a battery, a display window, an antenna clearance -- and none of those can be read off a board. "[]" here means NONE DECLARED, never "not considered". Declare them by hand; since #701 the seat search honours them, not only the grade.
